name: Music
description: Songs with independent lyrics and style drafts, judged on hook and craft, shipped as clips, shorts and audio releases.

axes.label: Hook
axes.description: Does the chorus stay with you after one listen?

axes.label: Lyrics
axes.description: Imagery, rhyme and whether a line earns its place.

axes.label: Emotion
axes.description: Does it move a listener who knows nothing about it?

axes.label: Production
axes.description: Arrangement, mix and how finished it sounds.

axes.label: Originality
axes.description: Distance from the obvious version of this idea.

axes.label: Visual potential
axes.description: Is there a clip in it, or only a cover?

prompts.label: Critique the lyrics
prompts.description: Weak lines, tired images, anything that does not sing.

prompts.label: Suggest a revision
prompts.description: A rewrite to react to, not to accept.

prompts.label: Draft a style prompt
prompts.description: A production description from the text.

prompts.label: Alternative titles
Score the song
prompts.description: Rate it along the profile axes, with a reason.
prompts.template:
Here are the lyrics of a song called "{title}".

{role:lyrics}

Judge it along these axes: Hook (Does the chorus stay with you after one listen), Lyrics (Imagery, rhyme and whether a line earns its place), Emotion (Does it move a listener who knows nothing about it), Production (Arrangement, mix and how finished it sounds), Originality (Distance from the obvious version of this idea), Visual potential (Is there a clip in it, or only a cover).

Be honest rather than kind: a score that flatters is worth nothing.
